newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirgroup unit may extend cargo handling.
newsitem.headline: SAirgroup unit may extend cargo handling.

text.p: SAirgroup logistics unit, Cargologic, is looking to expanding its airport cargo handling activities outside Switzerland, an article in the latest issue of the carrier's house journal said.
"At present we offer these services at Geneva and Zurich, but we are investigating various opportunities to enter the market in other European countries," it added.
It also said "We will be looking to offer new added-value products and services for our customer airlines and especially for forwarding agents where we have great opportunities."
Cargologic is the market leader in aircargo handling in Switzerland with a market share exceeding 85 percent, it said.

"We have some of the fastest import, export and especially trans-shipment times in the industry and in case the standard times are not fast enough we also have a"rapid channel"' for express handling, offering import, export, or trans-shipment Of loose cargo in one hour or less," it added.
"Import and export acceptance in Geneva is just 50 minutes", the article said.
It added that Cargologic "operates or will soon start operating, warehouses/hubs in Embrach-Embraport, Bern, Basel and Geneva."

The main trucking hub and warehouse is in Embrach-Embraport where there is a bonded warehouse with 20,000 sq m of warehousing on four floors, a truck parking lot and railway sidings. Ocean freight containers arriving by rail from the ports of northern Europa are also loaded and unloaded there. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
